name: Pick a Partner Poker
description: Pick a Partner is a stud poker variant for an even number of players. Everyone antes and receives five cards face down. All players simultaneously expose one card (roll). The highest card holder picks a partner; then the highest unpartnered player picks, until all are paired. Each partnership combines their eight remaining cards and selects three to use with their two upcards to form a five-card hand. Three betting rounds follow, with one of the three chosen cards turned face up after each round. Partners bet as individuals; the team with the best hand shares the pot, or one partner wins the whole pot if the other folded.

Pick a Partner is a stud poker variant from the Roll Your Own family. It combines ante, a simultaneous card expose (roll) for partner selection, and partnership hand formation with multiple betting rounds and gradual card reveals.

Each player antes. Dealer deals five cards face down to each player. All players simultaneously expose one card (roll). Highest card holder selects a partner; then the highest unpartnered player selects a partner, and so on until all are paired. Each partnership combines their eight remaining cards and selects three to use with their two upcards to form a five-card hand. Three betting rounds follow, with one of the three chosen cards turned face up after each round.
